Comment.Language: For the Commemoration of St. Shenute the Archimandrite and St. Besa his disciple:

Text.Language: <ere peniwt abba Senou] piar,/mand~ri-t/c: nem abba B/ca pefmay/-t/c nem nous/ri m~mona,oc.
Hail to our father Abba Shenute the Archimandrite and Abba Besa his disciple and their children the monks.
السلام لأبينا أنبا شنوده رئيس المتوحدين وأنبا ويصا تلميذه وأولادهم الرهبان.
